name: Sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes
short_description: Sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Ask for a location in another language helps develop sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes but is not indispensable.
Float with support for thirty seconds helps develop sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes but is not indispensable.
Exchange greetings in another language helps develop sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes but is not indispensable.
Give a two-step spoken direction helps develop sustain moderate movement for twenty minutes but is not indispensable.
This earlier capability remains useful but is not required by the revised route.
